name: calendar_acl_insert
description: Creates an access control rule; the rule is appended to the 'items' collection of the calendar's ACL row, matching how calendar_acl_list reads it. (POST /calendars/{calendarId}/acl)

calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method.

role.description: The role assigned to the scope. Possible values: 'none', 'freeBusyReader', 'reader', 'writer', 'owner'.

scope.description: The extent to which calendar access is granted by this rule: object with 'type' ('default', 'user', 'group', or 'domain') and 'value' (the email address of a user or group, or the name of a domain; omitted for type 'default').

send_notifications.description: Whether to send notifications about the calendar sharing change. Optional. The default is True. No mail is delivered in this sandbox.
